caseName: Martinez v. Court of Criminal Appeals
caseNameFull: Martinez v. Court of Criminal Appeals of Texas

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Application for temporary restraining order, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied. Justice Scalia, Justice Souter, and Justice Thomas took no part in the consideration or decision of this application and this petition.
